description: IS 10322 (Part 5/Sec 3) mandates that electronic LED drivers used within street light luminaires comply with electrical safety and surge withstand requirements of IS 15885 (Part 2/Sec 13).
IS 10322 (Part 5/Sec 3) normatively references IS 16103 (Part 1) for safety, creepage distance, and photobiological evaluation of LED modules integrated into luminaires.
Luminous efficacy, color rendering index (CRI), and photometric performance of lamps used in luminaires are tested per test methods in IS 16102 (Part 2).
Street lighting poles, distribution pillars, and luminaires must be effectively earthed according to IS 3043 Code of Practice for Earthing.
source: Central Public Works Department (CPWD) Electrical Specifications 2023 & IS 10322

description: IS 16102 Part 2 specifies the performance test methods and photometric measurements corresponding to the safety baselines established in Part 1.
Integral controlgear within self-ballasted lamps is evaluated against internal circuit safety criteria per IS 15885 (Part 2/Sec 13).
Industrial safety helmets (IS 2925) and safety harnesses (IS 3521) form the complementary personal fall and impact protection package for work-at-height operations.
source: Directorate General of Mines Safety (DGMS) & CPWD Safety Code

description: Both IS 2925 and IS 15298 (Part 2) are core statutory PPE components mandated under Ministry of Commerce Quality Control Orders for construction and industrial sites.
source: DPIIT Personal Protective Equipment Technical Regulations

description: Safety harnesses and protective footwear are coordinated safety equipment required in structural erection tenders to protect against falls and stepping on sharp objects.
source: CPWD Safety Manual for Construction Tenders

description: Respiratory protection half masks (IS 9473) and safety helmets (IS 2925) are co-procured for tunneling, quarrying, and demolition contracts.
source: Factories Act 1948 & National Building Code (NBC) 2016 Part 7

description: PVC building wire circuits must terminate into dedicated protective earth continuity conductors installed in compliance with IS 3043.
source: National Electrical Code of India (NEC) 2023 & IS 694

description: Current carrying capacity and thermal withstand of IS 694 cables dictate the overcurrent trip characteristics of protecting MCBs (IS/IEC 60898-1).
MCBs (IS/IEC 60898-1) provide short-circuit backup protection to RCCBs (IS 12640 Part 1) in consumer units and distribution boards.
Residual current devices rely on compliant earthing loop impedance (IS 3043) to safely clear earth leakage faults within 300 ms.
source: Central Electricity Authority (Measures Relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations

description: Rotomoulded water storage tanks (IS 12701) connect directly to uPVC potable water inlet and distribution pipe networks (IS 4985).
source: National Building Code of India (NBC) 2016 Part 9 Plumbing Services

description: Polyethylene raw materials for IS 12701 tanks must preserve drinking water potable quality without leaching contaminants prohibited under IS 10500.
uPVC water pipes must satisfy non-toxicity extraction limits (lead, cadmium, mercury) to prevent deterioration of potable water certified to IS 10500.
source: BIS IS 4985:2021 Clause 10 Toxic Substance Extraction

description: Centrifugally cast iron water pressure mains conveying water to treatment plants must satisfy lining non-toxicity to preserve IS 10500 standards.
source: CPHEEO Manual on Water Supply and Treatment

description: IS 456 Plain and Reinforced Concrete code normatively mandates that steel reinforcement bars conform to IS 1786 for yield strength and ductility calculations.
IS 456 specifies 43 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement conforming to IS 8112 as an authorized binder for structural concrete grades.
IS 456 specifies 53 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement conforming to IS 12269 for high strength concrete mixes, pre-stressed elements, and rapid construction.
Workers engaged in structural concrete casting, formwork strike, and reinforcement fixing under IS 456 must wear protective helmets per IS 2925.
source: IS 456:2000 Clause 14 & NBC 2016 Part 7 Construction Safety

description: IS 8112 (43 Grade) and IS 12269 (53 Grade) are the twin companion specifications for Ordinary Portland Cement differing in compressive strength development.
